mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates in equity valuation models, increasing present values of future cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.15%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% y/y, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), labor market slack suppresses wage pressures and inflation, prompting delayed monetary easing that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening consumer spending power, directly boosting corporate earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that triggers recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate severe demand shock, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as recession probability rises.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% y/y) with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), central bank constraint on tightening leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as delayed hikes are priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
